//: Repo root config so importing this repository deploys with no setup. The site is static: web/ is served as-is, there is no build step, and the wasm module is a committed artifact.

headers.//: 'wasm-unsafe-eval' is required: browsers treat WebAssembly compilation as script evaluation, so 'self' alone blocks it. It is the narrow grant for exactly this and, unlike 'unsafe-eval', does not re-enable eval() or new Function().
headers.value: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' blob: data:; media-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
